definitions: In a natural, untamed state, especially referring to animals or plants.
In a real-world, uncontrolled environment, especially referring to software or products after release.
examples: The photographer captured stunning images of lions in the wild.
It's exciting to see our new app being used in the wild by actual customers.
Many rare orchids only grow in the wild.
We need to test this feature in the wild before a full rollout.
